# objcas golden fixtures

Generated by the originating project's own code at commit `15ea0c51` (`lease.json` regenerated at `fc5d8be6` for the ADR-51 `InheritedTail` fields) with `golden-generator/` (see its README for the exact commands). Do not edit by hand; regenerate.

`lease.json`: a `Lease` with every optional field set, serialized by the originating code. `tests/golden.rs` parses it and serializes it back to the same bytes. The other direction: `cargo run -p replicix-objcas --example golden_out -- <outdir>` and `golden-gen verify`.
